additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0469601
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-IT SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / R9 170002722
Charger ID / Serial No.:
gy0noY
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
High
Handover reason:
Please proceed with the following troubleshooting:
If FB1 tripped, it means current was finding an unintended path to earth.
If FC5 tripped, it means too much current was flowing - doesn't seem like it.
​​​​Visual Inspection:
Charging Cable: Carefully inspect the entire length of the charging cable for any signs of damage: cuts, kinks, crushing, discoloration, or exposed wires. Check the connectors at both ends.
EV Charging Port: Look inside the EVs charging port for any debris, moisture, or damage to the pins.
Charger: Check for any visible damage, signs of overheating, or moisture.
Isolate and Test (If Possible & Safe):
If you have access to another charging cable, try using that (ensuring it's safe to do so).
From the logs I cannot see which component tripped. Please take spare FB1 and FC5 if need to replace anything.
Mit Freundlichen Grüßen/ Melhores Cumprimentos/ Best Regards
